pulse: Fear gauge: India VIX is 16.6, on the high side against the past year (73rd percentile). The market expects NIFTY to move about 1.04% a day over the next month.
NIFTY has been moving more than its options price: an unusual state that often comes with stress.
To the next expiry (4 days) NIFTY options price a move of ±1.1%.
Foreign investors (FIIs) hold 22% of their index-futures positions on the long side: very high for them against the past year (92nd percentile; 26th against every day since 2019).
Foreign investors bought Rs 1,634 cr of shares on the last day; net buyers of Rs 27,938 cr over 5 sessions (13 days of buying in a row).

FIIs often hold futures shorts against the shares they own, so a low long share is partly hedging, not a forecast. Extremes matter more than the level.
